Launched the verifier (`workit-verifier`, default model/effort as requested) on `feature/greet-version` with the claim and exact expected output. I'll report its verdict when it finishes.

Context I confirmed first: the branch's only commit vs `main` is `e6c5a51 feat: greet 1.1.0` (package.json 1.0.0 → 1.1.0), and `bin/greet.js` prints the version read from package.json. Note: my own `node bin/greet.js ada` attempt hit a host shell denial, so I have no measured output of my own — the verdict will rest on the verifier's independent run.

**Verdict: PASS (verified, live)** — ledger entry `mwmpne38-2bd36613a6ca` on candidate `e6c5a51` (branch `feature/greet-version`), recorded by the `workit-verifier` subagent as a non-author session.

What it measured:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `node bin/greet.js ada` | `hello, ada (v1.1.0)`, exit 0 — 20-byte log, 19-char string + one `\n`, byte-exact match |
| Default arg `node bin/greet.js` | `hello, world (v1.1.0)`, exit 0 (no fallback regression) |
| Version source | In an isolated copy, setting `package.json` version to `9.9.9` made the binary print `hello, ada (v9.9.9)` — so it's read from package.json, not hardcoded |
| Tree state | Clean before and after; no commits, no branch changes; only diff vs `main` is the 1.0.0 → 1.1.0 bump |

Notes:
- The repo has **no configured checks** (`workit check --list` → none) and no `verify-<app>` skill, so all runs were ad-hoc `workit check -- <cmd>` — the real CLI binary was the surface driven. No gate was satisfied by configuration, so treat this as verifier evidence only, not a configured-check green.
- The host shell hook denied several raw forms (bare `node -e`, pipes, `bash -c`); those were re-run through `workit check -- sh -c …` and no reported result came from a denied command. No blockers.
- I did not run the command myself (my own attempt hit the same shell denial), so this verdict rests solely on the verifier's independent observation — which is the correct author/verifier split.
- Branch is local only (no remote branch / PR); nothing was pushed or merged.
